claim: Table C.8.20-4, the Segment Description Macro, carries SegmentAlgorithmType (0062,0008) and does NOT carry SegmentAlgorithmName (0062,0009) or SegmentationAlgorithmIdentificationSequence (0062,0007). Those two are adjacent rows of Table C.8.20-2, the Segmentation Image Module, inside Segment Sequence, immediately after the row that includes Table C.8.20-4.
value: Table C.8.20-4 Segment Description Macro Attributes has 17 content rows and contains (0062,0008) at Type 1: "Segment Algorithm Type | (0062,0008) | 1 | Type of algorithm used to generate the Segment. Enumerated Values: AUTOMATIC calculated Segment SEMIAUTOMATIC calculated Segment with user assistance MANUAL user-entered Segment". It contains neither (0062,0009) nor (0062,0007). Table C.8.20-2 Segmentation Image Module Attributes has 23 rows; inside Segment Sequence (0062,0002) row 17 is the include of Table C.8.20-4, row 18 is ">Segment Algorithm Name | (0062,0009) | 1C | The name(s) of algorithm(s) used to generate the Segment. Required if Segment Algorithm Type (0062,0008) is not MANUAL." and row 19 is ">Segmentation Algorithm Identification Sequence | (0062,0007) | 3 | A description of how this Segment was derived. Algorithm Name (0066,0036) within this Sequence may be identical to Segment Algorithm Name (0062,0009). One or more Items are permitted in this Sequence."
